excerpt: You brought your deficit within the regional ceiling a year before it was due, and your partners have answered with dams, nutrition and coastal protection.
paras: You brought your deficit within the regional ceiling a year before it was due, and your partners have answered with dams, nutrition and coastal protection. Four in ten of you are under fifteen. The task is to turn a reputation for discipline into capital priced for it.

And they keep answering. In June 2026 the World Bank approved $320 million: $150 million for the first phase of the Dogo-Bis dam and $170 million, with the Global Financing Facility, for nutrition through Alafia. In January 2026 you issued your first international sukuk, $500 million over seven years, and in September 2026 you closed €500 million of bank financing under an African Development Fund guarantee.

The work ahead is plain, and it is worth saying plainly. Only eight in every hundred of you cook with clean fuel, and fewer than six in ten have electricity. Only sixteen in every hundred of you have safely managed sanitation, and fewer than eighteen in every hundred safely managed drinking water. Clean energy sets your Coverage today, at 8 out of 100, with sanitation and water close behind. Each of them is within your reach.

Now imagine that same resolve turned toward every home in the country. Picture Perfect Benin: a morning when every family cooks with clean fuel and sits down to a full table; when every tap runs clean and every home has a safe toilet; when every child walks to a school where a teacher is waiting, and reads with ease by the age of ten; when every mother lives within reach of a clinic with the lights on, and every young person finds work that pays. And no Beninese falls below a decent life, because the nation has decided that none will.
quote: You kept your word on the budget. Now let the markets price it, and let the price fund your children.
